answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: every agent answer is fingerprinted by sentence-rhythm, punctuation, vocabulary and embedding patterns, and a detector flags near-duplicate style across accounts, like a mirror exposing one hand writing many names. To evade it an attacker must run diverse models and perturb every output per identity, paying compute and hiring costs while quality degrades.
